question: Use the MendelianRandomization R package to test whether gene expression causally influences a phenotype, using SNPs as instrumental variables. Run both IVW and MR-Egger methods and report the results.

expected_output.guidelines: IVW and MR-Egger rows must be present (matched by case-insensitive method name); Beta must match within +/-0.05, SE within 20% relative absolute error, and p-values within one order of magnitude; row order and column header labels may differ.
